ext_description.message: Save images, text and links to an Inkadra board.

command_save_page.message: Save the page to the last board

boards_none.message: No boards you can add cards to.

connect_intro.message: Connect the clipper to your Inkadra server. You will be asked to sign in and allow access.

connect_permission.message: Chrome will ask for permission to contact this address only.

connect_hint_ids.message: If you built the extension yourself, the administrator must add its ID to CLIPPER_EXTENSION_IDS.

help_shortcut.message: Save the page to the last board used:

help_menus.message: Right-click an image, selected text, a link or the page to save it to the last board chosen from the toolbar button.

help_selfhost_text.message: The server only accepts the official extensions. For this one, the server administrator adds the ID below to CLIPPER_EXTENSION_IDS and restarts.

error_not_connected.message: The clipper is not connected to a server.

error_unauthorized.message: Access was revoked or has expired: reconnect the clipper.

error_forbidden.message: You are not allowed to add cards to this board.

error_not_found.message: The board no longer exists or is no longer shared with you.

error_too_large.message: The file is too large for this server.

error_offline.message: The server does not answer: check the connection.

error_rate_limited.message: Too many requests: try again in a minute.

error_invalid_server.message: There is no Inkadra server at this address.

error_permission_denied.message: Without permission to contact the server the clipper cannot work.

error_no_board.message: First choose a board from the Inkadra toolbar button.

error_server.message: Something went wrong on the server: try again.

error_clip_unconfirmed.message: Check the board before trying again.
